translations.web: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s slaves.”
translations.bsb: If any of your servants is found to have it, he must die, and the rest will become slaves of my lord.”
translations.kjv: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.
translations.asv: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.
